acceptanceCriteria: 20-line insertion above a method reports moved with the new range.
One-token edit inside the method reports changed.
Reformat-only change reports live or moved, never changed.
Spec/requirement updated in the same change.
body: For anchors naming a symbol, re-resolve the symbol in the live tree (same path, then repo) and compare a whitespace/comment-normalized region hash; report live/moved/changed/gone with the live location; Ruby and TS/JS at least, unresolved with reason otherwise; surface in docs flows check and corpus reader freshness fields. Source: https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/issues/1223
title: GH #1223: docs corpus re-resolves moved symbol anchors (live/moved/changed/gone) instead of marking them stale
